summary: Iteration 14 — Major TMS refactor (17 modifications). Backend: 30/30 pytest PASS covering Petty Cash CRUD+journal (5 categories), Purchase Orders (with/without AWB + auto-cost + receive-POD + cascade delete), Vendor Aging report, Charter mode (FCL/FTL/Lumpsum auto-detected, single-rupiah price, qty=0), Koli mandatory enforcement, Sender Suggestions (save on order + GET + DELETE), Reconcile blocked without received_at, Invoice 2-phase (create→no AR, mark-printed→AR posted DR1201/CR1290/CR2210, reprint with use_old_date keeps date, cancel reverts AWB + deletes journals + invoice doc), Bulk grouped invoices skipping cross-customer groups, Contract minimum_kg field. Frontend smoke: all 5 new pages (/petty-cash, /purchase-orders, /reports/vendor-aging, /orders/new, /invoices) render without crash; sidebar shows new modules; Koli field visible; service dropdown has FCL/Lumpsum.

minor.issue: serialize() did not handle list-of-ObjectId for new multi-AWB field 'awb_ids' → caused HTTP 500 on POST. PATCHED in /app/backend/server.py serialize() to recursively stringify ObjectId/datetime inside lists. Should be confirmed by main agent as the canonical fix.

verified_features: Koli mandatory: POST /api/orders without koli_count → 400 'Koli wajib diisi'
Charter auto-detect: service in (FCL, FTL, Lumpsum) → is_charter=true, qty_kg=0, total_tariff = charter_amount (or tariff_per_kg as fallback)
Sender memory: order with sender_name stored in sender_memory; GET /api/sender-suggestions?customer_id=… returns it; DELETE removes it
Petty Cash: POST creates entry + posts journal DR 5102 / CR 1101, all 5 categories accepted, invalid category rejected

Purchase Orders: PO without AWB → status=Open, no linked_cost. PO with AWB → auto-creates Vendor cost + journal DR 5101 / CR 2101 + links cost via linked_cost_id. receive-pod sets status='Received POD' + pod_date. DELETE cascade-deletes linked cost + journals
Vendor Aging GET /api/reports/vendor-aging returns {buckets:[0-30,31-60,61-90,90+], rows[], totals{...,total}}

Reconcile blocked: AWB without received_at → 400 'Barang belum diterima'. After POST /api/orders/{oid}/receive (requires received_by_name + work_type∈{Kirim Barang,Dismantle Barang,Relokasi Barang} + mode∈{Air,Trucking,Konsul}) → reconcile succeeds

Invoice 2-phase: POST /api/invoices → invoice_date=null, ar_recognized=false, print_count=0, NO journal posted. mark-printed (1st) → AR journal DR 1201 / CR 1290 (+ CR 2210 if tax) posted, invoice_date set, ar_recognized=true. mark-printed (2nd, use_old_date=true) → print_count=2, invoice_date unchanged. cancel → AWB → Reconciled, journals deleted, invoice doc gone
Bulk grouped: POST /api/invoices/bulk with grouped=[[a1,a2]] from DIFFERENT customers → group skipped with reason containing 'customer berbeda'
Cash advance settle: target='operation' breakdown → petty_cash entry created (no AWB cost); target='awb' → awb_cost created (verified via code review L5071-5103)
Contract minimum_kg: POST /api/contracts {minimum_kg:100} → saved and returned in response
Frontend: login + sidebar shows 'Petty Cash (Non-AWB)', 'PO / Surat Perintah Vendor', 'Aging Hutang Vendor'. Order form shows KOLI (JUMLAH) * field; service dropdown contains FCL/Lumpsum/FTL
action_items: Main agent: confirm the serialize() fix in /app/backend/server.py (lines 65-72) is acceptable — it now recursively stringifies ObjectId/datetime inside list values, which was required for new multi-AWB 'awb_ids' field on POST /api/invoices and /api/invoices/bulk. Without this, POST returned HTTP 500 'ObjectId is not iterable' from FastAPI's jsonable_encoder.

Optional: Seed default 3 customers / 4 contracts as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md — current preview DB has 0 customers, so tests must create TEST_IT14_* customer first. Either reseed or update the test_credentials.md.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py size 6046 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into routers (orders, invoices, petty_cash, purchase_orders, reports) for maintainability.
serialize() helper now handles list-of-ObjectId after this iteration's fix — but does NOT recursively serialize nested dicts (e.g., awb_breakdown items). Watch for future fields.
Invoice 2-phase logic in mark-printed (L1676-1742) correctly uses 'is_first' guard and idempotent ar_recognized flag; reprint with use_old_date branch is correct.

Charter detection (L1016) — is_charter = bool(data.is_charter) or service in (FTL,FCL,Lumpsum). LTL is NOT charter though service Literal allows it; main agent should confirm if LTL should also be charter.
Bulk invoice grouped logic (L1521-1606) properly enforces same-customer; uses first-error-aborts loop — could be enhanced to report ALL skip reasons per group but current behavior matches spec.
Petty Cash creation always credits cash account '1101' default; should respect cash_account_code param (it does via 'cash_acc' var) — verified OK.
cancel_invoice (L1744) does NOT reset ar_recognized flag — fine since invoice doc is deleted, but if re-invoiced same AWB, fresh doc gets fresh ar_recognized=false (verified by test flow).
DELETE /api/sender-suggestions/{sid} has no permission gate (require_role) — any authenticated user can delete any other customer's sender memory. Consider tighter scoping.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke (5/5 new pages render, login OK, key fields present)

seed_data_creation: Preview DB had 0 customers despite docs saying 3 seeded. Tests auto-create TEST_IT14_Customer_* and TEST_IT14_Customer2_* if missing. Each test also creates TEST_IT14_* AWBs, PCs, POs. Petty Cash test entries are cleaned up after assertion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_iteration14_tms_refactor.py -v. POST /api/orders requires service ∈ {LCL,FCL,LTL,FTL,AIR,Lumpsum} and via ∈ {D,L,U}. Cost creation: 'category' field is required by Pydantic — pass both cost_category and category. Operational/Lintas/Marketing costs require FINANCE role; Vendor cost requires OPERATION/ADMIN role. /api/orders/{oid}/receive requires received_by_name + work_type ∈ {'Kirim Barang','Dismantle Barang','Relokasi Barang'} + mode ∈ {'Air','Trucking','Konsul'}. Reconcile checks awb_costs presence AND received_at not null. Invoice 2-phase: POST /api/invoices only creates doc; AR journal posted only on mark-printed first time. Cancel deletes invoice doc + journals; AWB returns to Reconciled. Multi-AWB invoice via /api/invoices/bulk with grouped param.
rca_of_the_issue: Pre-fix serialize() bug: new fields awb_ids (list of ObjectId) introduced for multi-AWB invoice support were returned as raw ObjectId objects, which FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot encode (ValueError: 'ObjectId is not iterable'). Root cause: serialize() helper L59-70 only handled top-level scalar ObjectId/datetime, not list values. Fix: extend the loop to map each list element. Verified by passing all 30 tests including POST /api/invoices and POST /api/invoices/bulk.
